svg.title: Complete signal-to-quale transformation chain with inner control loop
svg.desc: A vertical diagram showing how physical signals transform through Takens embedding, AIS grating, and Moiré reconstruction into qualia in the moduli space, then back through mismatch and action to close the loop. Neuromodulation and slow plasticity are shown as side channels.
